notes: Rows the launch sees = requests in flight x tokens a request, for steps of at most 8 rows (wider steps leave this launch: Kimi-K3.1's wide launch or SGLang's path). In each mode the AgentX concurrency points C = 1, 2, 4, 8 session trees are weighted equally; the C-session in-flight count is the C-fold convolution of the per-session distribution, and only counts whose rows are <= 8 contribute (the mass that fits: decode 84%, verify 23% of the steps); each mode's weights are then normalized and the two modes averaged. Every width 1..8 is estimated above 10 us (the launch streams ~69 MB of dense weights a rank plus 2.2 MB a distinct picked expert at ~5 TB/s, behind about ten in-kernel hand-offs), so the perf range is the whole observed range.
